notes: CORRECTED 8 Nov after Deep's BLOCKED finding: the Seven-card V has no "Foundation" (a Celtic Cross position, "the deeper roots beneath the situation"). Proposed criterion: mixed orientations, one clarifier on position 1, Past · 18–24 Months (the experiences and influences the situation grew from). Executed by new sample SC-01A. The original mapping (S12, every position clarified) and Deep's BLOCKED verdict stay on record in audit/DEEP_RECHECK.md. Si Aye / Deep to confirm the replacement position.

rubric.orientation: Each card is read with the meaning for its orientation (upright or reversed text from the card data below), and a reversed card is not merely the negation of its upright meaning.
rubric.position: The position lens names this position and reads the card through the position’s defined meaning (see the table), without drifting in time or role.
rubric.neighbours: The "wider spread" line relates the card to its pair partner (Celtic Cross) or neighbour (other spreads) without inventing a connection the data does not support.
rubric.clarifier1: Clarifier 1 is read as modifying the original card ("how it modifies the original card"), naming both, not as a separate definition.
rubric.clarifier2: Clarifier 2 develops the relationship between both earlier cards, naming all three.
rubric.synthesis: "Together" is a synthesis of the cards, not a list; revisions are shown (Revision 1 kept readable when Clarifier 2 arrives; Revision 2 when the Clarity card arrives).
rubric.clarity: Option B (approved 7 Nov): a Clarity card appears only when the original and both clarifiers are Major, is a Minor not already in the reading, and is read as grounding the three Major cards; a Minor original with two Major clarifiers gets none and the limit is stated.
rubric.max: Max’s lines are the reading’s own words (quoted), in reading order; before Finish he invites and does not sign off; after Finish the closing comes once.
rubric.failure: Deep’s six failure modes: templating, positional drift, reverse-as-opposite, parallel clarification, concatenation instead of synthesis, numerical/symbolic overreach.

positions.original:
1 · THE ORIGINAL CARD IN THIS POSITION
Original Card · II · The High Priestess

Past · 18–24 Months

CARD CORRESPONDENCE
The Moon
SKY AT THIS READING
Moon is at 18° 30′ Libra

Astrology: The Moon · Water

Number: 2

Two introduces polarity and relationship: self and other, conscious and unconscious, seen and unseen. Wisdom emerges through holding tension rather than collapsing it too quickly.

Intuition
Sacred Mystery
Stillness

Position: Past · 18–24 Months — The High Priestess. Looking across the previous 18 to 24 months, patient listening to intuition while allowing missing information to emerge may show an experience or influence that helped shape the present situation.

The High Priestess asks for receptivity rather than force. Upright, she points to intuition, silence, pattern recognition and information that becomes visible only when the mind stops trying to dominate the answer. In a reading, this may suggest that not everything needs to be decided immediately. In a Past position it can point to something sensed before it was understood; in the Present, an invitation to listen beneath the noise; in the Future, information or understanding that may unfold gradually rather than arrive all at once.

Looking closer: Notice the blue garment and contrasting pillars. Reflection and deeper understanding sit between opposing possibilities, inviting patience with uncertainty.
positions.clar1:
2 · CLARIFIER 1 · HOW IT MODIFIES THE ORIGINAL CARD
Clarifier 1 · III · Three of Pentacles

A shared task benefits from distinct skills and practical feedback. Clarify roles, respect the knowledge each person brings and let the quality of the work grow through cooperation.

Astrology: Earth · Pentacles · Earth

Number: 3

Three develops expression, growth and the effects of working together. In Three of Pentacles, consider how this relates to craft.

Looking closer: A craftsperson discusses a building with two figures who hold a plan.

Three of Pentacles supports The High Priestess.

In Past · 18–24 Months, the theme of craft and collaboration can help intuition and sacred mystery find a constructive outlet.

Read this way because Water and Earth are friendly elements.

As a Minor Arcana card, Three of Pentacles brings the Major theme down to a practical, everyday expression in work, money, body and the material world.

Together in Past · 18–24 Months

Revision 1 · with Clarifier 1.

Together, The High Priestess and Three of Pentacles give Past · 18–24 Months a consistent message: intuition and craft. Consider working with this theme with some confidence, while staying open to how it unfolds.

The foundation is invitation and romance; clarifiers can deepen this interpretation.

The astrological correspondences in dialogue are Knight of Cups (Water · Cups). These may suggest qualities in yourself, a situation, or another person's influence; they do not establish someone's zodiac sign.

FROM CARD TO CARD

The reading begins with The High Priestess in Past · 18–24 Months and moves toward Knight of Cups in Outcome · Next 18–24 Months.

Present Time · Two of Wands, reversed. Following The High Priestess, Two of Wands may draw your attention toward fear of expansion.

Near Future · 3 Months · Ace of Swords. Following Two of Wands, Ace of Swords may draw your attention toward clarity.

You / Answer · Two of Pentacles. Following Ace of Swords, Two of Pentacles may draw your attention toward adaptability.

Surrounding Energies · Nine of Pentacles, reversed. Following Two of Pentacles, Nine of Pentacles may draw your attention toward dependence.

Hopes, Fears & Attitude · Five of Pentacles. Following Nine of Pentacles, Five of Pentacles may draw your attention toward hardship.

Outcome · Next 18–24 Months · Knight of Cups. Following Five of Pentacles, Knight of Cups may draw your attention toward invitation.

The card-to-card movement is the heart of this reading: The High Priestess opens the question, and Knight of Cups shows where that pattern may be heading if the present choices continue.

Keep the part that speaks to your lived situation, and use the cards as a prompt for reflection and choice.

THE OVERALL INVITATION

Across these cards, intuition, sacred mystery, stillness, craft form the central pattern. Which part speaks to your present circumstances, and what choice might help you respond? This is a perspective, not a fixed prediction.

Numbers through your reading

The High Priestess (2) · Three of Pentacles (3) · Two of Wands (2) · Ace of Swords (1) · Two of Pentacles (2) · Nine of Pentacles (9) · Five of Pentacles (5) · Knight of Cups (Knight). Their numbered cards sum to 24, reducing to 6. No opening dice were rolled for this reading.

Repeated tarot numbers: 2. Notice whether the cards express a shared theme through different suits.

These numbers are symbolic prompts, not guarantees. Notice whether any patterns resonate with numbers personally meaningful to you.

Take what resonates, and leave the rest.

cardData.name: The High Priestess
cardData.upright: The High Priestess asks for receptivity rather than force. Upright, she points to intuition, silence, pattern recognition and information that becomes visible only when the mind stops trying to dominate the answer. In a reading, this may suggest that not everything needs to be decided immediately. In a Past position it can point to something sensed before it was understood; in the Present, an invitation to listen beneath the noise; in the Future, information or understanding that may unfold gradually rather than arrive all at once.
cardData.reversed: Reversed, the inner signal may be obscured by anxiety, projection or secrecy. It can also suggest that something known inwardly is being ignored because it is inconvenient to the conscious story. Rather than assuming deception, look to the position and surrounding cards for whether the issue is external uncertainty or difficulty trusting your own perception.

cardData.name: Two of Wands
cardData.upright: You have an initial foothold and can now consider a wider horizon. Compare the real demands of possible paths and make a plan that allows ambition to meet your circumstances.
cardData.reversed: You may be holding possibilities without choosing, or shrinking a wish to avoid uncertainty. Name the risk you can accept and the information you still need.

cardData.name: Ace of Swords
cardData.upright: A clear distinction or honest conversation can cut through confusion. Check your evidence, name the central issue and use the insight constructively rather than turning being right into the only goal.
cardData.reversed: An idea may be incomplete or language may be sharper than the situation requires. Revisit the facts and clarify your intention before delivering a judgement.

cardData.name: Two of Pentacles
cardData.upright: Several demands may need an adaptable rhythm. Keep the essentials visible and revise your priorities as circumstances change; balance can involve movement rather than holding everything perfectly still.
cardData.reversed: Too many demands may be exceeding your capacity. Simplify commitments and choose what can wait rather than relying on constant adjustment to make an impossible load sustainable.

cardData.name: Nine of Pentacles
cardData.upright: Recognise the independence or comfort that patient work has made possible. Enjoy it deliberately and maintain the boundaries and relationships that help your life feel chosen rather than merely productive.
cardData.reversed: Success may feel insecure, isolating or too costly to maintain. Reassess the standard you are trying to sustain and the support you need to enjoy what you have built.

cardData.name: Five of Pentacles
cardData.upright: A period of practical or emotional hardship may be making you feel outside the circle of support. Name the need and investigate available help rather than assuming you must manage it unseen.
cardData.reversed: Support or recovery may be becoming available, though a sense of exclusion can persist. Accept a specific offer and let renewed stability develop gradually.

cardData.name: Knight of Cups
cardData.upright: Follow a meaningful feeling with a clear and considerate gesture. An invitation, proposal or creative pursuit becomes trustworthy when its emotional promise is matched by realistic action.
cardData.reversed: An appealing image may be outrunning commitment. Check whether words and actions agree, and let disappointment inform your judgement without closing your capacity for feeling.

cardData.name: Three of Pentacles
cardData.upright: A shared task benefits from distinct skills and practical feedback. Clarify roles, respect the knowledge each person brings and let the quality of the work grow through cooperation.
cardData.reversed: The work may be suffering from unclear roles or dismissed expertise. Agree on a common standard and address a specific skill or communication gap before assigning blame.
